about_content:
Blinkit coupons and grocery offers

Blinkit lets shoppers order groceries and everyday essentials for delivery in supported areas. Set your delivery address before comparing products and offers.

Choose a coupon by its eligible payment method, minimum spend and maximum saving. A percentage discount with a cap is not a flat discount on every basket. Compare the final payable amount, including delivery and other checkout charges.

Is there a free coupon code for a Blinkit first order?

No universal first-order code was confirmed in the sources reviewed for this page. Check promotions shown to your signed-in account. Read our Blinkit welcome coupon guide for help checking eligibility.

Can existing users use Blinkit coupon codes?

Check each offer rather than assuming it is restricted to new users. The bank offers listed here depend on the specified card and transaction conditions.

How do I compare discounts?

Keep the basket and pack sizes the same. Check the discount cap, excluded products and fees. Avoid adding unwanted items merely to qualify for a coupon.

Explore more grocery offers or browse all stores.

Rating source: 4.7/5 for the Blinkit iPhone app on the India App Store, checked 8 September 2026. This is an external app rating, not a CouponPush customer-review score.
howto_content:
1. Open Blinkit and set your delivery address.
  2. Add the products you need and check the offer minimum.
  3. Review card eligibility, excluded categories and usage limits.
  4. Enter the listed code in the checkout coupon or bank-offer field.
  5. Select the eligible payment card and confirm the discount and final total before paying.

Why is my Blinkit coupon not working?

Check the code spelling, card type, minimum transaction value, excluded products and whether you already used the monthly allowance. A day-specific offer will not apply on other days. If the discount still does not appear, check the live terms or contact Blinkit through the app.

Does a coupon guarantee free delivery?

No. Review delivery and other charges separately in the order summary.
terms_content:
Sources reviewed 8 September 2026. These offers were checked against bank-published information, not tested in a customer checkout. Availability can change.

  • Bank offers require the specified eligible card and may have minimum spend, category exclusions and monthly limits.
  • Check the offer dates and eligible day before ordering. An unspecified expiry does not mean a permanent offer.
  • Do not assume coupons can be combined. Cancelled or refunded purchases may lose promotional benefits.
  • First-order promotions depend on the individual campaign; no universal welcome discount is promised.

Sources: Axis Bank NEO benefits, Axis Bank AMEX Blinkit offer and Blinkit promotional terms.
